summary_en: Software that formats and pushes a portfolio of listings out to portals and partner networks.
summary_fr: Le logiciel qui met en forme et pousse un portefeuille d'annonces vers les portails et les réseaux partenaires.

tools.name: Apimo
tools.positioning: The French transaction system built for agencies that sell across borders — multilingual, multi-currency, open API.
tools.description: Apimo is a real estate CRM and transaction platform used by French and international agencies: listings and contacts, mandates, matching, multilingual publishing to portals in several countries, websites, and a documented open API.
tools.real_estate_use: Agencies on the Côte d'Azur, in the Alps or in border regions sell to buyers who do not read French, through portals in several countries. Apimo handles a listing in multiple languages and currencies from one record, which removes the duplicate-catalogue problem that breaks most domestic tools as soon as a second market appears.
features: Multilingual and multi-currency listing management
Publishing to French and international portals
Mandate management and buyer matching
Website generation from the catalogue
Documented open API for integrations
Rental and seasonal rental modules

use_cases.job: Market one property in several languages and currencies without duplicating the record
Publish to French and foreign portals from a single catalogue

tools.name: ListHub
tools.positioning: Listing syndication and reporting for MLSs, brokers and agents, plus a normalized MLS data feed for the publishers that display those listings.
tools.description: ListHub is a syndication platform operated by Move, Inc. that takes listing data out of a multiple listing service and distributes it to a network of more than 170 real estate websites. It serves two sides of the same pipe: on one side MLSs, brokerages and agents who decide where their listings travel and who read back performance reports on each destination; on the other side publishers, who consume MLS content through a customizable API covering sources in all fifty states under a single contract, delivered in RESO-normalized form. A separate Global offering pushes listings to overseas audiences, and a Connector product synchronizes with Realogy's database.
tools.real_estate_use: A broker of record who has just signed a listing does not want to re-key it into every portal, and does not want it appearing on sites they never agreed to. They connect their MLS feed to ListHub once, then use the dashboard to opt each publisher in or out, and read the per-site reporting to see which destinations actually produced views and leads before renewing anything. On the other side of the same platform, a portal or a regional real estate magazine that needs live inventory subscribes to the publisher API rather than negotiating with hundreds of MLSs one by one.
features: Listing syndication to a network of over 170 real estate websites
Per-publisher opt-in and opt-out control for brokers
Listing performance reporting across destination sites
Publisher API delivering RESO-normalized MLS data from all 50 states
ListHub Global for international listing distribution
Connector synchronization with Realogy's database

use_cases.job: Decide site by site where the office's listings are syndicated, and withdraw from a publisher without touching the MLS entry
Check which destination websites generated views on a listing before renewing an advertising commitment
Source live, normalized MLS listing data through one API instead of contracting with each MLS separately

tools.name: Poliris
tools.positioning: Software, website and distribution from one French vendor, with a long history in portal feed management.
tools.description: Poliris supplies French agencies with transaction software, agency websites and listing distribution to portals, historically as one of the main feed operators in the French market.
tools.real_estate_use: Its practical value to an agency is the same as Ubiflow's — one catalogue, many destinations — with the software and the site included rather than integrated. Agencies that do not want to assemble a stack from three vendors buy the whole chain here and accept the trade-off of less choice at each layer.
features: Multi-portal listing distribution
Transaction software with listings and contacts
Agency website generation
Lead consolidation across channels
Media and format handling per portal
Reporting on publication and lead volume

use_cases.job: Buy software, website and portal distribution from a single vendor
Keep one catalogue as the source for every published channel

tools.name: Previsite
tools.positioning: Content production and distribution suite for real estate agents: photo, video, virtual tour, a dedicated site per listing and social media publishing.
tools.description: Previsite publishes a set of marketing tools for real estate agents, gathered in an all-in-one mobile application called Smartpix Pro. The application produces the visual content of a listing — optimized photographs, dynamic videos and virtual tours — with the vendor stating a professional-quality result in under five minutes. Around it sit a dedicated single-property website for a mandate, and Social Connect Pro, a turnkey product that manages an agency's social accounts, distributes listings automatically and works on local visibility. Other named products include Mooveo and SpotVideo. The company is French, with offices in Hyères and Paris.
tools.real_estate_use: An independent agent who has just signed a mandate is expected to be photographer, videographer and community manager on top of the job itself. With Previsite they shoot the property on a phone through Smartpix Pro, which returns edited photos, a video and a virtual tour without a studio pass; the mandate gets its own single-property page to send to the owner as proof of work and to buyers as a landing page. Social Connect Pro then pushes the listing to the agency's social accounts on a schedule the agent does not maintain by hand, which is what keeps a small agency visible locally between listings.
features: Application Smartpix Pro regroupant photo, vidéo et visite virtuelle
Photographies optimisées et vidéos d'annonce assistées par IA
Visite virtuelle consultable à distance par l'acquéreur
Site mandat dédié à un bien
Social Connect Pro — gestion et diffusion automatique sur les réseaux sociaux
Diffusion des annonces pour la visibilité locale de l'agence

use_cases.job: Produire photos, vidéo et visite virtuelle d'un bien depuis un téléphone, sans prestataire externe
Tenir la présence de l'agence sur les réseaux sociaux avec une diffusion automatique des annonces
Donner à un mandat son propre site pour le montrer au vendeur et le servir aux acquéreurs

capabilities: Assisted video generation from listing media

tools.name: SweepBright
tools.positioning: A mobile-first agency CRM for European markets — capture a property on site, publish it before leaving.
tools.description: SweepBright is a real estate agency platform used across Belgium, France and other European markets: property and contact management, mobile listing capture with photos, matching, multi-portal publishing, digital signature and an agency website module.
tools.real_estate_use: The design assumption is that the agent is never at a desk. Capturing the property during the valuation visit — rooms, photos, description — and publishing directly from the phone compresses a two-day cycle into the appointment itself, which matters most in competitive markets where the first published listing gets the enquiries.
features: Mobile property capture with photos and details on site
Contact management and buyer matching
Multi-portal publishing across European portals
Agency website module fed by the same catalogue
Digital signature on mandates and offers
Team activity and pipeline reporting

use_cases.job: Capture and publish a new listing from the phone during the valuation visit
Run a multi-country European agency on one catalogue and one portal feed

tools.name: Tenant Turner
tools.positioning: Leasing automation for US property managers: syndicate the listing, pre-qualify the lead, let the prospect book a showing and open the door themselves.
tools.description: Tenant Turner automates the leasing cycle between a vacant unit and a signed lease. It imports listings from the property management system and pushes them to more than twenty listing sites, applies the manager's own pre-qualification criteria before a prospect can book, and offers either in-person showings or self-showings through electronic lockboxes and smart locks. Prospects self-schedule around the clock; reminders, cancellation of unconfirmed appointments, post-showing feedback collection and application dispatch run automatically. The Ultra plan adds a live answering service for leasing calls. Reporting covers lead flow, showing activity, lockbox use and owner-facing performance.
tools.real_estate_use: Vacancy costs a US property manager more than almost anything else in the operating budget, and the bottleneck is rarely demand — it is the coordination. Someone has to answer the phone, decide whether the caller meets the income and pet rules, agree a time, and physically be at the property. Tenant Turner removes all four steps: the pre-qualification questions gate the calendar, the prospect books at any hour, and a lockbox or smart lock grants access without a staff member driving across town. The manager sees which listings produce leads and which produce no-shows, and hands the owner a report that explains a slow lease-up with numbers. It sits alongside the property management system rather than replacing it, which is why it shows up in the integration directories of the major platforms.
features: Listing import from the property management system and syndication to 20+ listing sites
Customisable lead pre-qualification gating access to the showing calendar
Self-showings via electronic lockboxes and smart locks, or in-person showings
24/7 prospect self-scheduling with reminders and automatic cancellation of unconfirmed appointments
Post-showing feedback collection and automatic application dispatch
Leasing analytics and owner reports covering leads, showings and lockbox use

use_cases.job: Fill a vacant single-family unit without a staff member attending every showing
Screen out unqualified enquiries before they reach the calendar and see why a listing is not converting

capabilities: AI virtual leasing agent marketed for handling prospect enquiries

tools.name: Ubiflow
tools.positioning: The French multi-portal distribution layer — one feed in, every portal out, with the format differences absorbed.
tools.description: Ubiflow is a listing distribution platform for French real estate professionals: it takes a catalogue from an agency's software or a developer's system and publishes it to portals, partner sites and marketplaces, normalising formats and reporting on performance per channel.
tools.real_estate_use: France has no MLS, so distribution is a job in itself: each portal has its own format, its own media rules and its own contract. Ubiflow absorbs that. An agency or a promoteur maintains one catalogue, and gains a per-portal view of leads and cost — which is the data needed to decide which subscriptions to renew.
features: Single feed distribution to French portals and partner sites
Format normalisation and media handling per channel
Lead consolidation and per-portal performance reporting
New-build programme distribution for developers
Publication rules and quota management per contract
Connectors to French agency software

use_cases.job: Publish one catalogue to every portal and see which subscription actually pays
Distribute a new-build programme across portals and partner networks
